name: Bahaadini et al. 2017 merged-view CNN
source: Table 1 (right column, merged view model) and Sec. 3.2; Fig. 3 of the paper. The best model (96.89%).
unknowns: Activation of the 256-unit fully connected layer is not stated
Flatten before the dense layers is not drawn
Convolutions are 2-D (5x5 kernels, 2x2 pooling) on a 94x114 image; the style has no 2-D glyphs, so the 1-D types are used
notes: The paper also gives a single-view CNN (two conv 128 5x5 + 2x2 pool + ReLU, FC 256, softmax 20, input 1x47x57, one duration) and a parallel-view model (four per-duration conv 128 5x5 + 2x2 pool + ReLU branches merged, then one more conv stage, FC 256, softmax 20). Only the merged view is drawn.
